en.name: Large JSON / NDJSON Explorer
en.description: Open large JSON and NDJSON files directly in your browser. Validate, browse the structure, search records, and export rows to CSV locally — no upload, and no fixed cap for the files the regular tools cannot handle.

meta.title: Large JSON to CSV — Explore & Export Big JSON/NDJSON Files Online
meta.description: Convert large JSON and NDJSON files to CSV in your browser. Validate, preview the structure, search records, flatten nested fields, and download CSV locally for files up to 20 MB and beyond.
keywords: convert large json file to csv

features.title: Local validation
features.desc: The whole file is scanned in a Web Worker. Syntax errors are reported with the exact line, column, and a preview of the failing line.

features.title: Structure overview
features.desc: Detect record collections (root array, data.items, features, NDJSON lines), record counts, and sampled fields with types and example values.

features.title: Lazy structure tree
features.desc: Stream the whole document through a Worker and browse it as an expandable tree, without ever materialising the file as one giant object in memory.

features.title: Column selection
features.desc: Pick exactly which fields become CSV columns. Nested fields like customer.email are flattened automatically.

features.title: Record search
features.desc: Search across records by value or field name. Matches are listed with their record index and path.

features.title: Streaming CSV export
features.desc: CSV is generated in chunks and downloaded as a Blob, so memory stays low even for tens of thousands of rows.

features.title: Private by design
features.desc: Everything runs in your browser. Your file is never uploaded to a server.

guide.p: Drag a .json, .ndjson, .jsonl or .jsonlines file onto the page, or click to choose one. Format is detected from the extension, or pick it manually.
The tool scans the file and shows the record count and candidate collections. Choose the array that represents your rows.
Select the fields to export. Nested objects are flattened (customer.email becomes its own column). Arrays can be exported as JSON, the first item, or skipped.
Preview 50 rows to confirm, then export the full CSV. The download is generated locally and streamed to your device.

faq.a: This page handles every input that is too large for the regular tools (above 5 MB), and files up to about 20 MB are comfortable. Larger files still work locally, but the actual speed depends on the file structure and your device memory.

faq.q: Why was I sent here from the JSON Editor or JSON to CSV?
faq.a: Those pages target everyday, smaller documents. When an input is above the limit, it is handed over to this page, which processes big files inside a Web Worker so the browser stays responsive. Your content is carried over automatically — you do not have to upload it again.
NDJSON (also called JSON Lines or JSONL) stores one JSON value per line. Each line is a record, which makes it ideal for logs and event exports. This tool validates each line independently.
No. Validation, search, structure browsing and CSV export all run in your browser using a Web Worker. The file never leaves your device.

faq.q: Why can't I edit the file here?
faq.a: Editing very large text in the browser is slow and memory-heavy. This tool is focused on validation, browsing, search and export. For smaller files, use the JSON Editor.

article.title: Convert large JSON and NDJSON files to CSV in your browser
article.headline: A private, local workflow for big record exports
article.body:
Exporting a large JSON array or an NDJSON log file to a spreadsheet should not require uploading your data. This page validates, previews and converts files locally.

The most common path: upload a 20–50 MB orders or events export, pick the record array, choose your columns (including nested fields like customer.email), preview 50 rows, then download a CSV you can open in Excel, Google Sheets or a BI tool.

For files above 100 MB, a command-line tool such as jq, Python or DuckDB is usually faster. This tool targets the practical middle ground where a quick, private, in-browser check and export is exactly what you need.

meta.title: 大文件 JSON 转 CSV — 在线浏览与导出大型 JSON / NDJSON
meta.description: 在浏览器中将大型 JSON 与 NDJSON 转为 CSV。验证、预览结构、搜索记录、展平嵌套字段并本地下载 CSV。
keywords: 大文件 json 转 csv

features.title: 本地验证
features.desc: 整个文件在 Web Worker 中扫描，语法错误会报告精确行号、列号与失败行预览。

features.title: 结构概览
features.desc: 识别记录集合（根数组、data.items、features、NDJSON 行）、记录数，并对字段采样给出类型与示例值。

features.title: 懒加载结构树
features.desc: 通过 Worker 流式解析整个文件并以可展开的树形浏览，不会在内存中生成完整对象。

features.title: 选列导出
features.desc: 精确选择哪些字段成为 CSV 列，嵌套字段（如 customer.email）自动展平。

features.title: 记录搜索
features.desc: 按值或字段名在记录中搜索，结果列出记录序号与路径。

features.title: 流式 CSV 导出
features.desc: CSV 分块生成并以 Blob 下载，数万行也能保持低内存。

features.title: 隐私优先
features.desc: 全部在浏览器中运行，文件不会上传到服务器。

guide.p: 将 .json / .ndjson / .jsonl / .jsonlines 文件拖入页面，或点击选择。格式按扩展名自动识别，也可手动选择。
工具扫描文件并显示记录数与候选集合，选择代表行的数组。
选择要导出的字段，嵌套对象会被展平（customer.email 成为独立列）。数组可导出为 JSON、首项或忽略。
先预览 50 行确认，再导出完整 CSV，下载在本地生成并写入设备。

faq.a: 本页承接所有超出常规工具处理能力（5 MB 以上）的输入，20 MB 以内体验最佳；更大的文件仍可在本地处理，实际速度取决于文件结构与设备内存。

faq.q: 为什么我从 JSON 编辑器 / JSON 转 CSV 被引导到这里？
faq.a: 这些页面面向日常的小文件。当输入超过限制时会自动交由本页处理：大文件在 Web Worker 中解析，浏览器不会卡死。内容会自动带过来，无需重新上传。
NDJSON（又称 JSON Lines 或 JSONL）每行一个 JSON 值，每行即一条记录，非常适合日志与事件导出。本工具逐行独立验证。
不会。验证、搜索、结构浏览与 CSV 导出都在浏览器内的 Web Worker 中完成，文件不会离开你的设备。

faq.q: 为什么不能在这里编辑文件？
faq.a: 在浏览器中编辑超大文本既慢又占内存。本工具专注于验证、浏览、搜索与导出；更小的文件请使用 JSON Editor。

article.title: 在浏览器中将大型 JSON 与 NDJSON 转为 CSV
article.headline: 针对大型记录导出的本地私有工作流
article.body:
把大型 JSON 数组或 NDJSON 日志导出到表格，没必要上传数据。本页在本地完成验证、预览与转换。

最常见的路径是：上传 20–50 MB 的订单或事件导出，选择记录数组，挑选列（含 customer.email 这类嵌套字段），预览 50 行，然后下载可在 Excel、Google Sheets 或 BI 工具中打开的 CSV。

超过 100 MB 的文件，命令行工具（如 jq、Python、DuckDB）通常更快。本工具面向的是「快速、私密、在浏览器里完成检查与导出」这一中间场景。
